in_arabic.name: شُبْحِي
in_arabic.meaning: الشُبْحِيُ مِنَ الأَسْمَاءِ الجَمِيلَةِ وَالمَعَانِي الرائِعَةِ
in_arabic.long_meaning: الشُبْحِيُ اسمٌ مشتقٌ مِنَ الشَبَحِ وَهُوَ الوَجهُ الحَسَنُ الجميلُ، يوصف به الشخص الحسن الوجه، الحسن الخُلُق. ورد ذكره في بعض الأحاديث النبوية، وقد استخدمه العرب قديماً لوصف الأشخاص ذوي الوجه الحسن.

in_urdu.name: شبھی
in_urdu.meaning: شبھی ایک خوبصورت اور معنی خیز نام ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: شبھی نام عربی زبان کے جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت چہرہ یا خوشگوار حلیہ۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیا میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان مقبول ہے، خاص طور پر پاکستان اور بھارت میں۔ اس کا تعلق اسلامی ثقافت اور عربی لسانی ورثہ سے ہے۔

in_hindi.name: शुभी
in_hindi.meaning: शुभी एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है
in_hindi.long_meaning: शुभी नाम का अर्थ है सुंदर चेहरा या अच्छा रूप। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत पसंद किया जाता है। इसकी जड़ें अरबी भाषा में हैं और यह इस्लामी संस्कृति का हिस्सा है।

in_pashto.name: شبهي
in_pashto.meaning: شبهي د ښکلي نومونو څخه يو
in_pashto.long_meaning: شبهي نوم د عربي ژبې څخه مشتق شوی دی، چې د ښکلي مخ يا خوشحاله چهرې معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو تر منځ مشهور دی او د هغوی په کلتور کې مهم ځای لري.

in_english.long_meaning: Shubhi is derived from Arabic roots, meaning a person with a beautiful face or pleasant appearance. The name has historical significance in Islamic tradition and is used across various Muslim cultures. It symbolizes good looks and pleasant demeanor.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Shubhi" is deeply rooted in various Islamic and Middle Eastern cultures where the Arabic language holds significance. It is thought to be a beautiful and especially meaningful name, conveying a sense of radiance, brilliance, and auspiciousness. Radiance can be interpreted as having a bright, glowing, and joyful personality. Brilliance encompasses intelligence, achievement, and success. Auspiciousness signifies being fortunate and favored.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the name "Shubhi" is associated with representing the divine light that emanates from Allah, the supreme deity in Islam. It focuses on the inner light that resides in every person, urging them to strive towards excellence and righteousness in their lives. The name also highlights the idea that every individual has the potential to shine and illuminate their surroundings with their good actions, positive influence, and moral virtues. In the holy texts of Islam, it is often mentioned that, "Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth." Thus, carrying the name "Shubhi" is a constant reminder of being a carrier of that light and spreading it in the world.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Qutaybah, Al-Jamhwa wa'l-Nawamis, Volume 1, Page 353 The name Shubhi carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mention of Shubhi ibn Al-Harith as a poet from Bahrain, who was known for his excellent eloquence and his devotion to the Prophet Muhammad.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Khaldun, The Muqaddimah, Volume 1, Page 13 The name Shubhi carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Description of the Arab tribes of the pre-Islamic period, mentioning Shubbiyah as a sub-tribe of the Yemenite Himyarite tribe, known for their poetic tradition and their use of the 'Shubhi meter' in their poetry.

It is frequently seen on social media platforms such as Instagram, where users with the name Shubhi showcase their personal style and interests. Blogs and websites dedicated to Islamic names and their meanings also feature the name Shubhi, providing an educational resource for those exploring their cultural identity. In the fashion and lifestyle industry, designers and brands often incorporate Islamic names and symbols into their products and marketing strategies, further contributing to the popularity and modern usage of the name Shubhi.
